surfaces.name: glass_hud

entry_surfaces./: Expedition Cockpit dashboard — live Leaflet bicycle route map with GPS waypoint HUD on left/center, fast-entry telemetry logger & real-time stats panel right

layout_architecture.grid_layout: 2-column asymmetric desktop dashboard: Left/Main 60% Map Canvas with floating StreetView HUD pill & GPS Waypoint tracker; Right 40% Control & Telemetry Panel (Progress Bar, Add Km Form, Milestones/Etappen, Recent Logbook Entries). Mobile stacks smoothly into sticky map viewport + scrollable action sheet.

route_creation.routing_service: OSRM Bicycle profile (bike-friendly route coordinates & total distance calculation in km)

map_and_tracking.library: leaflet & react-leaflet with Leaflet tile layer (OpenStreetMap / Carto Positron)

visual_route_rendering.completed_path_style: solid glowing neon emerald line #059669 / #10b981, weight 6
visual_route_rendering.current_position_marker: Animated Pulsing Cyclist Pin (Custom SVG with directional glow)

street_view_feature.mechanism: Generates direct URL `https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&viewpoint=${lat},${lon}` and opens in a new tab with rel='noopener noreferrer'
street_view_feature.reverse_geocoding: Shows current approximate town/region name near current coordinate (e.g. 'In der Nähe von Rovereto')

fields.name: note
fields.label: Notiz / Rollentraining Notiz
fields.placeholder: z.B. Abends auf dem Smart-Trainer, Regen draußen

actions: Schnellwahl-Buttons: +5 km, +10 km, +25 km, +50 km für Smart Trainer Workouts

progress_metrics.progress_bar: Segmented energetic gradient bar (Emerald to Amber to Cyan) with percentage indicator & target milestone flag

completion_celebration.ui: Full-screen celebration modal with confetti effect, badge 'Etappensieg erreicht! 🏆', certificate of completion, and instant action button 'Nächste Tour planen & starten'

log_history_and_stats.history_table: Collapsible log list with Date, Km, Note, and Delete button with confirmation
log_history_and_stats.stats_chart: Recharts Weekly & Daily bar chart showing kilometers ridden over time
log_history_and_stats.archive_system: View past completed routes with completion date, total days taken, and average daily km

components.description: Top bar with App title, active route snippet, 'Neue Route' dialog trigger, 'Archiv' trigger, and Dark/Light toggle.
Interactive Leaflet map showing full polyline, completed sub-polyline, start/finish flags, and pulsing current cyclist marker with Street View action pill.
Floating glassmorphic HUD pill on the map displaying current calculated lat/lon, nearest town estimate, and bold Google Street View launcher button.
Hero stats row showing completed km, remaining km, total km, completion % and high-contrast dynamic progress bar.
Fast-entry form with date picker, km numeric input, preset chips (+5km, +10km, +25km, +50km), optional note, and submit CTA.
Card showing ride history logs with delete action per item, timestamps, and empty state guidance.
Dialog or tab with Recharts weekly riding bar chart, streaks, average km/day, and riding metrics.
Modal with Start & Ziel Nominatim autocomplete search, curated preset routes, and route preview with elevation / distance.
Modal showing list of completed virtual tours with achievement badges.
Modal popping up when a route reaches 100% with confetti animation, tour summary, and 'Next Tour' trigger.

motion_and_interactions.map_pan_on_entry: Smooth flyTo animation on Leaflet map to the current calculated waypoint when a new km entry is logged
motion_and_interactions.pulsing_marker: CSS keyframe pulse animation around the current cyclist position marker ring
motion_and_interactions.progress_fill: motion.div width transition with spring easing (stiffness: 100, damping: 15)
motion_and_interactions.entry_item_stagger: List item exit/enter slide-down animation with AnimatePresence
motion_and_interactions.confetti: Lightweight canvas confetti trigger upon 100% goal reached

accessibility_and_contrast.aria_roles: aria-live='polite' for km progress announcements, role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow and aria-valuemax

instructions_to_main_agent: Install leaflet and @types/leaflet plus canvas-confetti via yarn in frontend directory.
Import leaflet/dist/leaflet.css in index.css or main.tsx and fix default Leaflet marker icon asset resolution issues.
Implement OSRM bicycle routing backend API proxy or direct query: `https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/biking/${startLon},${startLat};${destLon},${destLat}?overview=full&geometries=geojson`.
Calculate the exact current coordinate along the GeoJSON Linestring based on cumulative completed kilometers.

Create rich default seed data with a pre-configured exciting route (e.g. München nach Venedig, 560 km, with 142.5 km already ridden and 4 history entries) so the app looks vibrant immediately on first load.
Ensure the Google Street View button creates a direct tab `https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&viewpoint=${lat},${lon}` based on the exact calculated current coordinate.
Ensure all text is in polished German language ('Virtuelle Radtour', 'Gefahrene Strecke', 'Kilometer eintragen', 'Street View öffnen', etc.).
Support quick-add buttons (+5, +10, +25, +50 km) for rapid testability and treadmill/indoor trainer logging convenience.
Persist routes, entries, and archive in MongoDB backend with clean fallback to sample state if backend is offline.
